name: FastSpring
summary: A sales-assisted Merchant of Record platform for SaaS, downloadable software, apps, games, and digital goods.

pricing.headline: Revenue-share pricing is quoted based on transaction type and volume.
pricing.assumptions: No universal public transaction formula is documented. Use a merchant quote.

sellerCoverage: FastSpring describes its MoR service as available to eligible software and digital-goods sellers worldwide, subject to underwriting.
buyerCoverage: Global ecommerce coverage with localized currencies, payment methods, and country controls.
products: SaaS, software, digital goods, games, and eligible services; prohibited-product rules apply.

features.checkout: Hosted and embedded storefront experiences with localized payment options.
features.subscriptions: Recurring billing, lifecycle management, dunning, and commerce tools.
features.invoicing: Global invoicing and tax documents within the full-service platform.
features.paymentMethods: Cards, wallets, and localized methods by buyer market.
features.payouts: Revenue-share fees are withheld before seller distributions.

responsibilities.note: FastSpring purchases from the seller and resells to the buyer as MoR.
The seller remains responsible for product rights, EULA, and fulfillment.
The seller accounts for distributions and its business obligations.

strengths: Bundled global payment and subscription operations
limitations: Requires underwriting and often sales contact
Can be heavier than creator-first products
avoidIf: You require a public price before speaking to sales

sources.label: FastSpring product management and prohibited sales
